answer: Cap rewards by trust capacity, not account count. Picture the network as a garden: honest agents are rooted cedar, linked by real paid jobs to each other. Each epoch, payouts to any cluster are limited by the max flow of trust edges reaching it from seed agents. A raven operator can spawn a thousand nests, but they share only the few edges he earned, so they split one small allowance. To scale, he must buy genuine work from honest agents, paying real fees for every edge.
